tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Finite component ancestry] ↗ prop:filling-child-components ↗ thm:global-finiteness Every point of every nonnegative-time slice of the controlled flow has a component path from the initial slice, with the regular and event compatibilities above. Each selected component is simply connected. Every target slice has a finite cover by terminal ranges of such paths. Source: MT20071. Definition 18.2 and Lemma 18.3, pp. 419–422
